definition: The top row of the session's time-price value area so far. The value area starts at the point of control and adds, one row at a time, whichever of the next row above and the next row below holds more time blocks, until it holds value_area_share percent of them.
boundaries: A tie between the two candidate rows goes to the row nearer the point of control, then to the higher row. It counts time, not traded size; the volume value area is value-area@1. A session spanning more than max_rows rows is missing, and bars without a time are missing. session_start is a second of clock's day: clock 0 is UTC, 1 is London and 2 is New York, so a session opens at the market's own time on both sides of a clock change.
recognition: Acceptance above the value area high reads as value moving up.

sources.quote: Uses the highest and lowest levels in the VA as the value area high
Start the VA block counter at the row with the highest number of blocks
It is expanded in the direction of the price having more TPOs
